name: Doc card subtitle / +->chevron swap

recordedWith.viewport: 360x800 CSS px, deviceScaleFactor 2, mobile, touch emulation

t0: t=0 = the click event of the tap
setup: {"js":"APP.go('docs')"} ; {"until":"document.querySelector('.app-docs .ps-doc')"} ; {"wait":1200} ; {"js":"APP.pickFile = PS.pickFile = function (a, then) { then(null, new File([new Uint8Array(1153434)], 'Payslip_Sept_2026.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' })); }"} ; {"tap":".app-docs .ps-doc .ps-doc__head","hold":40} ; {"wait":800}
propertyLegend: x/y/w/h = getBoundingClientRect (CSS px, includes transforms); tx/ty/sx/sy/rot = computed transform matrix decomposed (px, scale, deg); blur = filter blur px; opacity = computed opacity of the element itself; opacityEffective = product of ancestors; other names are computed CSS values.
notes: App proof-of-income page: DocCard add -> 'Choose from files' with PS.pickFile stubbed to hand over a 1.1 MB PDF (no file dialog in headless). The card opens, the + swaps to the chevron and the subtitle swaps as the file goes compressing -> uploading -> done.
